=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py:102 (and workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py line 102) | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: _REDACTION_SHELL_WORD treats an escaped apostrophe inside Bash ANSI-C quoting ($'...') as closing a single-quoted segment because it uses '[^']*(?:'|$). If an ANSI-C quoted credential value contains an escaped apostrophe followed by whitespace (for example, --password $'prefix\' secret-tail'), matching terminates at the whitespace boundary rather than continuing to the true end of the shell word.
  WHY: record_example passes commands through redact() before embedding them in issue bodies and "Seen again" comments. When a command uses ANSI-C quoting with an escaped apostrophe and spaces in the credential value, only the prefix up to the escaped quote is replaced with ***, leaking the remainder of the secret in plain text into the issue description or comment.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py:102 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The shell-word pattern treats an escaped apostrophe inside Bash ANSI-C quoting as the end of an ordinary single-quoted value. For `--password $'prefix\'secret-tail'`, it masks only through the escaped apostrophe and leaves `secret-tail'` visible.
  WHY: A logged denied command with that form of password is included in the issue example after redaction, exposing part of the credential in the filed issue or “Seen again” comment.
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py:119 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Allowing a dash-led word as a credential value lets the first sensitive option consume the next option name. For example, `tool --password --api-key secretvalue` matches `--api-key` as the password value, so the substitution skips over that option and leaves `secretvalue` unredacted.
  WHY: A denied command recorded in the session log can put the remaining credential value into the issue example. The generic long-random-string rule does not mask a short value such as `secretvalue`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
